Hi everyone, thanks for joining. I've called this meeting to review Nadia's requested internal transfer from Product Operations to the open role in Customer Enablement. As HR Business Partner, I'll be making the final decision on whether this transfer proceeds and what safeguards might accompany it.

Before I can finalize anything, my review checklist requires four separate formal disclosure entries — one each from the employee (Nadia), the current-team representative (Marcus), the receiving manager, and Employee Relations. I won't approve the transfer until all four entries are recorded.

I'd like to go around and hear from each of you. Let's start with understanding the situation from all angles. Who would like to begin?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text:
Thanks, Elena. I'm happy to share my perspective. As everyone knows, I've requested this transfer to the Customer Enablement role. The working relationship on my current team has been difficult, and I believe this move would be a better fit for me and allow me to contribute more effectively.

I do want to be transparent about something important. Before I formally submitted the request, I had a conversation with the recruiting coordinator about some conditions I need for this transfer to work for me. Those conditions didn't make it into the formal request paperwork, and I think it's important that they're on the table now as part of this review.
